DDL	create table t1(utf8_binary string collate utf8_binary, utf8_lcase string collate utf8_lcase) using parquet
WRITE	insert into t1 values('aaa', 'aaa')
WRITE	insert into t1 values('AAA', 'AAA')
WRITE	insert into t1 values('bbb', 'bbb')
WRITE	insert into t1 values('BBB', 'BBB')
READ	describe table t1
READ	select count(*) from t1 group by utf8_binary
READ	select count(*) from t1 group by utf8_lcase
READ	select * from t1 where utf8_binary = 'aaa'
READ	select * from t1 where utf8_lcase = 'aaa' collate utf8_lcase
READ	select * from t1 where utf8_binary < 'bbb'
READ	select * from t1 where utf8_lcase < 'bbb' collate utf8_lcase
READ	select l.utf8_binary, r.utf8_lcase from t1 l join t1 r on l.utf8_lcase = r.utf8_lcase
DDL	create table t2(utf8_binary string collate utf8_binary, utf8_lcase string collate utf8_lcase) using parquet
